title: Guest Towel Holder Stand, Allied Brass, Polished Nickel
description: Guest towel holder stand for bathroom vanity countertops, 11-inch size, crafted from solid brass with traditional styling — available in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. Use as a guest towel holder, hand towel stand, or washcloth holder with a two-arm towel bar design that keeps towels within reach of the sink. Countertop, freestanding, vertical stand (no wall mount) with a heavy base to help prevent tipping and a felt pad on the bottom to protect countertop surfaces. Dimensions: 16.3 inches L x 14 inches H x 5.5 inches W (16.3 in, 14 in, 5.5 in). Weight capacity: 20 lb. No assembly required.  for matching Carolina and heritage bathroom fixtures. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass Carolina collection.
